Home/Emergency/Seizures
Emergency situation?

Do not waste time reading if the animal is not breathing or unconscious. Call a vet immediately.

CRITICAL

Seizures

During a seizure, do not put your hands in the cat's mouth, do not try to hold it down, and clear away nearby hard objects so it doesn't injure itself. Time the seizure: if it is the first one, lasts several minutes, recurs, or the cat does not regain consciousness afterward, urgent help is needed; after the seizure, keep the animal in a quiet place and contact a clinic right away.

See a vet TODAY (do not wait)

The information in this app comes from open sources and the experience of cat owners. It does not replace a consultation or an examination by a vet. Decisions about your pet's health and care are the owner's to make — if in any doubt, contact a vet.
